name: Eco-Shop Marketing Berhad
summary: Eco-Shop Marketing Berhad, an investment holding company, operates a chain of essential stores in Malaysia. The company engages in the retailing of groceries, general consumer goods, food and beverage; wholesale business of rice, oil, flour, and sugar; and e-commerce and online business for selling a range of products. It also manufactures plastic products in primary forms; and provides transportation and warehousing services. Eco-Shop Marketing Berhad was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Jementah, Malaysia.
